text: Dar Global is the international development arm of Dar Alarkan Real Estate Development Co. It was established in 2017 as Dar Alarkan International Real Estate Development, is listed on the London Stock Exchange, and focuses on global luxury real estate investments and developing international assets.

In mid-2024 Dar Global reported development projects valued at about $5.9 billion across the UAE, Oman, Qatar, the UK, Spain and Bosnia. By December 2024 Dar Global described roughly $7.5 billion of projects under development in six countries including the UAE, Qatar, Saudi Arabia and the UK (Fortune).

Trump Tower Jeddah is a SAR 2 billion (about $531 million) project on Jeddah's Corniche, planned as one of the city's tallest residential towers. In February 2025 Dar Global awarded the enabling works contract to Specialized Italian Foundation Co. Ltd. (SIFCO). Dar Global is also advancing a Riyadh mega-project of 200 premium residential villas.

Trump Plaza Jeddah is a planned $1 billion mixed-use project on King Abdulaziz Road in Jeddah, announced in September 2025. It is to include premium residences, serviced apartments, Grade-A office space and exclusive townhouses. Trump Tower Jeddah is a 47-floor luxury development on the Red Sea coast that entered its pre-construction phase, as confirmed by Eric Trump in May 2025.

Dar Global and The Trump Organization announced Trump Tower Jeddah in July 2024, building on the Trump International Oman project within the AIDA development, a $500 million mixed-use initiative. It targets both the luxury Saudi market and international investors. CEO Ziad El Chaar said the partnership aims to redefine Saudi Arabia's high-growth real estate market. A Trump Tower Dubai was also announced with Dar Global.

In December 2024 Dar Global signed an agreement with The Trump Organization to build two landmark projects in Riyadh, targeting the luxury Saudi market and international investors. The Trump-branded properties are managed under a licensing agreement with The Trump Organization.

Wasalt is a joint venture between Dar Al Arkan, a leading Saudi real estate developer with more than 27 years of experience, and Quara Holding, a technology startup incubator and innovation hub. It is a website and app specialising in real estate brokerage. Offerings include online solutions for the real estate and rental markets, easy access to property specialists, and several mortgage provider options for home finance.

Wasalt describes itself as a Saudi AI-backed real estate platform for verified properties and trusted brokers. Users can buy, rent, browse developer projects, and use daily rentals. Landlords and brokers can list properties for sale or rent across Saudi Arabia. The platform also lists government and private real estate auctions and international luxury properties.

Wasalt is licensed by REGA, the General Real Estate Authority, as a real estate portal, and holds a license from the Entrustment and Liquidation Center (Infath) to organise and manage electronic and hybrid real estate auctions. It offers real-time bidding and direct award services, and sale agents can list Infath-assigned auctions on the platform.
In January 2025 Wasalt reported more than 750,000 registered users and 100,000 monthly leads, describing itself as a leader in Saudi Arabia's PropTech landscape after four years.

Wasalt is a subsidiary of Quara Holding Group and provides AI-driven property search, client-agent matchmaking (Wasalt Matchmaker), auctions, and Wasalt Projects on a single platform. Christie's International Real Estate launched a luxury brokerage in Saudi Arabia in partnership with Wasalt. Ziad Chaar is Chairman of Wasalt, and the company filed for an IPO on the Saudi Parallel Market.
The Wasalt app is free on iOS. Through Wasalt Projects, users can learn about projects from elite Saudi developers and book an apartment, duplex or villa for sale using a bank card.

DarGlobal and Wasalt are related through Dar Al Arkan: Dar Global is Dar Al Arkan's international development arm, while Wasalt is a joint venture between Dar Al Arkan and Quara Holding. Ziad El Chaar is CEO of Dar Global and Chairman of Wasalt.
